record.title: Sanitised errors and the never-log floor

record.observed_gap: nothing prevents paths, upstream text or secrets reaching error output.

title: Every exit-21 and exit-1 cause has a machine-readable code

record.title: Every exit-21 and exit-1 cause has a machine-readable code
record.requirement: every cause of exit 21 (not running, unwrapped name, strict-modes, server verification, endpoint lost mid-call) and of exit 1 (already live, stale heartbeat, squatted name, pinned-hash mismatch, script child, strict-modes or socket-directory refusal, internal error) reaches `--json`, MCP and the process log as a distinct code with no path or pid, matching the human hint for the same cause.
record.observed_gap: exit 21 and exit 1 each have several causes; design now gives one hint per cause in human mode, but arch fixes `{"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":null}` for exit 21 and gives exit 1 no `--json` document (A:292-294; DS cli pattern 2 "pending an arch amendment"); obs's codes lack stale heartbeat and unwrapped name (OB §6 detail code catalog, D-20), and strict-modes or socket-directory refusals at `run`/`ui`/`mcp` start have no code (XF X7, T4, F4, B6).

verification.acceptance: Each cause reaches its own closed code on each surface it reaches, carrying no path or pid and matching the human hint of that cause. Exit 21: strict-modes-failed, instance-dead (not running), unwrapped-name, endpoint-lost and server-verify-failed, printed in detail under --json as {"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"<cause>"} and returned by MCP as the same body less v, its text refused: instance-unreachable; on the process log as the process-exit detail of each cause a log is open for, exit 21 at WARN, endpoint-lost with during call. Exit 1, in the error of {"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null} on revive --json and the catch site under --json, and in the process-exit detail: strict-modes-failed, already-live, no-session, session-live, cwd-missing, stale-heartbeat, batch-script-child, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, internal-error; verify's refusals on the process-exit it writes under a VIOLA_NAME: program-not-found, version-unreadable, unclean-fixture, pinned-hash-mismatch, batch-script-child, strict-modes-failed, interrupted. Each human form ends stderr with that cause's own hint: line (internal-error none), and no hint two codes share (tests/cross_exit_causes.rs no_two_codes_share_a_hint beside its planted-duplicate control shared_hints_reads_a_planted_duplicate). Witnesses: tests/cross_exit_causes.rs, crates/viola-mcp/tests/handlers.rs, tests/security_negatives_server_identity.rs, tests/cli_instance_state.rs, tests/cli_verify.rs. Named apart, on the founder's own word (chunks/2026-10-31-exit-cause-code-catalogue/inputs/I2-relay-1.md.txt Q4): a strict-modes check refused before a log opens writes no line; MCP reaches only the exit-21 causes its five tools can meet and writes no line, isError its record; run and verify have no --json, so their causes reach the log and the hint, run's start also through revive --json; viola mcp's own exit 1 keeps both streams empty; macOS's server check and the socket-directory refusal stay with the route entry "Unix endpoint and home hardening".
verification.ref: tests/cross_exit_causes.rs (its cases per cause and mode, ::no_two_codes_share_a_hint, ::shared_hints_reads_a_planted_duplicate, ::no_hint_names_release, ::every_code_is_a_code_word); crates/viola-mcp/tests/handlers.rs::handlers_frame_tools_name_the_cause_of_an_unreachable_instance + ::handlers_frame_tools_refuse_a_widened_instance_before_any_frame + ::handlers_frame_tools_write_no_frame_to_a_server_that_is_not_the_recorded_wrapper; crates/viola-e2e/tests/mcp_tools.rs::mcp_tools_a_wrapper_killed_under_a_parked_wait_reads_endpoint_lost; tests/security_negatives_server_identity.rs::security_negative_cli_verb_writes_no_frame_to_a_server_that_is_not_the_recorded_wrapper; tests/cli_instance_state.rs::revive_json_of_a_stale_holder_is_the_stale_heartbeat_document + ::run_refuses_a_stale_name; tests/cli_verify.rs::verify_an_unreadable_version_refuses_and_writes_no_stamp + ::verify_a_tampered_pinned_copy_refuses_with_its_code + ::verify_window_a_widened_stamps_file_refuses_with_its_code + ::verify_a_batch_script_refuses + ::verify_record_refuses_a_path_outside_the_home + ::verify_stopped_by_a_signal_removes_only_its_own_dirs_and_exits_1

title: CLI contract: machine output, typed exits, cause-named hints

record.title: CLI contract: machine output, typed exits, cause-named hints
record.requirement: every verb has a `--json` form mirroring the channel result and a typed exit code (0, 1, 2, 10–14, 20, 21); human output follows the design phraseology (readback mirror for `send`, one `hint:` naming the next step per cause, results on stdout and context on stderr); a global `--home` isolates all state; `config.json` sets thresholds, port and diagnostics level, and no setting can switch off a security control.
record.observed_gap: the prototype prints free text; drivers need parseable refusals (A:98).

verification.acceptance: Every driver-facing verb (send, wait, last, answer, list, pause, release, and revive with --list) has a --json form printing one stdout document that mirrors the channel result, or the documented error form where none exists ({"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable"|"wrapper-fault",…}, instance-unreachable's detail its closed cause, and revive's exit-1 {"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null} with the code one of strict-modes-failed, already-live, stale-heartbeat, no-session, session-live, cwd-missing, batch-script-child, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, internal-error, each refusal of the start revive shares with run included: one document, exit 1, stderr empty). Stderr is empty and the exit is typed from {0, 1, 2, 10-14, 20, 21}, read side by side per outcome in tests/cli_machine_contract.rs and the landed per-verb cases it names. In human mode, results go to stdout and context to stderr, each refusal cause ends stderr with its own hint: line, no hint names release, and send prints its readback mirror (the landed literal pins in tests/cli_send.rs, tests/cli_wheel.rs, tests/cli_revive.rs, tests/cli_list.rs and the trycmd mirror). A global --home isolates all state (the two-home case in tests/cli_machine_contract.rs). The home resolves --home, then the VIOLA_DIR grandparent through the one shape check, then the default, and is canonicalised once it exists. config.json sets the budget thresholds and the diagnostics level, and no config.json key, global flag or VIOLA_* variable switches off a control (the completeness case in tests/cli_controls_not_disableable.rs over schemas/config.v1.json). The port clause left 0.1.0 by the founder's 2026-10-16 ruling (this capability's notes).

title: Bounded, validated inputs at every boundary

record.title: Bounded, validated inputs at every boundary
record.requirement: every external reader is size-capped, depth-limited and closed-typed; names are validated before any path join; a bad `Last-Event-ID` pair drops the whole header; the paste rule is enforced client-side and authoritatively in the wrapper; a terminal-parser panic degrades to `input-not-ready` without harming passthrough.
